title: Keysound Sound Recipe v1
description: A Sound Recipe is the complete parameter set produced by the Sound Lab (DJ board). It fully describes how one keystroke event is rendered into sound: layered synthesis (click / body / release / space), optional sample layers, master FX, humanization, and per-key-category overrides. A recipe is a plain JSON file (a few KB), shareable and importable.

version.description: Recipe format version. Engines must reject recipes with a newer major version.

tags.description: Free-form tags for the community gallery, e.g. ['thock', 'deep', 'realistic'] or ['8bit', 'animalese', 'toy'].

basedOn.description: Optional id/name of the parent recipe this was remixed from.

renderMode.description: realtime = synthesize per keystroke via AVAudioSourceNode (Sound Lab mode). prerender = bake variations to buffers at load time (low-power / performance mode). Same recipe, two render paths.

layers.description: The four channel strips of the DJ board. Every keystroke renders all enabled layers and mixes them.

click.description: Attack transient: the initial 'tick' when the switch bottoms out. Physically a short filtered noise burst.

hpFilterHz.description: High-pass cutoff. Higher = sharper, more 'clacky' tick.

sharpness.description: Macro: simultaneously raises hpFilterHz and shortens durationMs.

body.description: The thock/clack core: modal resonance of keycap + plate + case. Synthesized as 1-4 exponentially decaying resonators.

q.description: Resonance bandwidth. Higher Q = more tonal 'ping', lower Q = duller 'thud'.

basePitchShift.description: Global pitch offset of the body in semitones. The primary thock(deep) <-> clack(bright) control.

release.description: Key-up sound: switch stem returning. Independent layer triggered on key release, not on key down.

inheritFrom.description: 'click' = reuse the click layer scaled by gain (good default). 'none' = use the embedded params below.

noise.description: Same shape as layers.click.noise, used when inheritFrom = 'none'.

pitchShift.description: Release sounds are naturally slightly higher than downstrokes.

space.description: The room the keyboard sits in.

stereoWidth.description: 0 = mono center. 1 = keys panned by physical position (left hand keys lean left).

fx.description: Stylized effects chain. Off by default; these power the 'toy' recipes (8-bit, Animalese-like, lo-fi).

macros.description: Simple-mode controls (the XY pad and skeuomorphic knobs). Each macro sweeps multiple DSP params at once. 'path' uses dot notation into this recipe, e.g. 'layers.body.basePitchShift'.

x.description: Default X axis of the pad: thock <-> clack.

y.description: Default Y axis of the pad: soft <-> hard.

humanize.description: Per-keystroke randomization. Mandatory for realism: without it, any sound becomes a machine gun within 30 seconds.

pitchJitterSt.description: Random pitch offset per keystroke, in semitones (±).

timingJitterMs.description: Random sub-perceptual onset jitter; also decorrelates layer alignment.

keymap.description: Per-key-category overrides. Categories match the existing sample-pack engine: generic / space / enter / backspace / modifier. Values are offsets applied on top of the base recipe.

keyPitchMode.description: 'rows' = pitch follows physical key rows (top row higher). 'pentatonic' = keys mapped to a pentatonic scale, typing becomes musical. Powers the playful recipes.

sampleLayer.description: Hybrid mode: replace or blend this synth layer with a user-imported sample (their own recorded keyboard, a chess piece, anything).

pitchShift.description: Semitones relative to the base recipe. Spacebar typically -2 to -4 (deeper, like stabilizers).
